panels.title: 命名空间级别最大资源使用分析

targets.rawSql:
-- 各命名空间在高峰时段的资源用量,以及占整体的比例
WITH per_namespace AS (
  SELECT
    namespace,
    count(DISTINCT deployment)              AS deployment,
    sum(pod_count)                          AS pod,
    sum(p95_pod_load * pod_count)           AS load,
    sum(p95_pod_wss_mb * pod_count)         AS mem,
    sum(request_pod_cpu_m * pod_count / 1000.0) AS cpu_request,
    sum(limit_pod_cpu_m   * pod_count / 1000.0) AS cpu_limit,
    sum(request_pod_mem_mb * pod_count)     AS mem_request,
    sum(limit_pod_mem_mb   * pod_count)     AS mem_limit
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE date = '${maxday}'::timestamptz AND ${env}
  GROUP BY namespace
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    sum(deployment)  AS total_deployment,
    sum(pod)         AS total_pod,
    sum(load)        AS total_load,
    sum(mem)         AS total_mem,
    sum(cpu_request) AS total_cpu_request,
    sum(cpu_limit)   AS total_cpu_limit,
    sum(mem_request) AS total_mem_request,
    sum(mem_limit)   AS total_mem_limit
  FROM per_namespace
)
SELECT
  n.namespace,
  n.deployment,
  n.deployment::numeric  / NULLIF(t.total_deployment, 0)  AS deployment_percentage,
  n.pod,
  n.pod::numeric         / NULLIF(t.total_pod, 0)         AS pod_percentage,

  n.cpu_request,
  n.cpu_request          / NULLIF(t.total_cpu_request, 0) AS cpu_request_percentage,
  n.load,
  n.load                 / NULLIF(t.total_load, 0)        AS load_percentage,
  n.cpu_limit,
  n.cpu_limit            / NULLIF(t.total_cpu_limit, 0)   AS cpu_limit_percentage,

  n.mem_request,
  n.mem_request          / NULLIF(t.total_mem_request, 0) AS mem_request_percentage,
  n.mem,
  n.mem                  / NULLIF(t.total_mem, 0)         AS mem_percentage,
  n.mem_limit,
  n.mem_limit            / NULLIF(t.total_mem_limit, 0)   AS mem_limit_percentage
FROM per_namespace n
CROSS JOIN totals t

panels.title: 【${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}~${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}最大资源使用的日期：${maxday}】【各命名空间级别】高峰时段P95资源使用量与资源占整体资源比例

targets.rawSql:
-- 各微服务在高峰时段的资源用量,以及占所选命名空间的比例
WITH per_deployment AS (
  SELECT
    namespace,
    deployment,
    sum(pod_count)                          AS pod,
    sum(p95_pod_load * pod_count)           AS load,
    sum(p95_pod_wss_mb * pod_count)         AS mem,
    sum(request_pod_cpu_m * pod_count / 1000.0) AS cpu_request,
    sum(limit_pod_cpu_m   * pod_count / 1000.0) AS cpu_limit,
    sum(request_pod_mem_mb * pod_count)     AS mem_request,
    sum(limit_pod_mem_mb   * pod_count)     AS mem_limit
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE date = '${maxday}'::timestamptz AND ${env} AND ${namespace}
  GROUP BY namespace, deployment
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    sum(pod)         AS total_pod,
    sum(load)        AS total_load,
    sum(mem)         AS total_mem,
    sum(cpu_request) AS total_cpu_request,
    sum(cpu_limit)   AS total_cpu_limit,
    sum(mem_request) AS total_mem_request,
    sum(mem_limit)   AS total_mem_limit
  FROM per_deployment
)
SELECT
  d.namespace,
  d.deployment,
  d.pod,
  d.pod::numeric / NULLIF(t.total_pod, 0)         AS pod_percentage,
  d.cpu_request,
  d.cpu_request  / NULLIF(t.total_cpu_request, 0) AS cpu_request_percentage,
  d.load,
  d.load         / NULLIF(t.total_load, 0)        AS load_percentage,
  d.cpu_limit,
  d.cpu_limit    / NULLIF(t.total_cpu_limit, 0)   AS cpu_limit_percentage,

  d.mem_request,
  d.mem_request  / NULLIF(t.total_mem_request, 0) AS mem_request_percentage,
  d.mem,
  d.mem          / NULLIF(t.total_mem, 0)         AS mem_percentage,
  d.mem_limit,
  d.mem_limit    / NULLIF(t.total_mem_limit, 0)   AS mem_limit_percentage
FROM per_deployment d
CROSS JOIN totals t

panels.title: 每日高峰时段P95内存使用率

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date AS "time",
  deployment AS metric,
  max(pod_count) AS value
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND ${env} AND ${namespace} AND ${deployment}
GROUP BY "time", metric
ORDER BY "time"

-- 单个 Pod 维度的高峰时段用量与使用率(不乘 pod_count)
WITH per_pod AS (
  SELECT
    namespace,
    deployment,
    sum(pod_count)                   AS pod,
    sum(p95_pod_load)                AS load,
    sum(p95_pod_wss_mb)              AS mem,
    sum(p95_pod_cpu_pct)             AS cpu_pct,
    sum(p95_pod_wss_pct)             AS mem_pct,
    sum(request_pod_cpu_m / 1000.0)  AS cpu_request,
    sum(limit_pod_cpu_m   / 1000.0)  AS cpu_limit,
    sum(request_pod_mem_mb)          AS mem_request,
    sum(limit_pod_mem_mb)            AS mem_limit
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE date = '${maxday}'::timestamptz AND ${env} AND ${namespace}
  GROUP BY namespace, deployment
),
totals AS (
  SELECT sum(pod) AS total_pod FROM per_pod
)
SELECT
  p.namespace,
  p.deployment,
  p.pod,
  p.pod::numeric / NULLIF(t.total_pod, 0) * 100 AS pod_percentage,

  p.cpu_request,
  p.load,
  p.cpu_pct,
  p.cpu_limit,

  p.mem_request,
  p.mem,
  p.mem_pct,
  p.mem_limit
FROM per_pod p
CROSS JOIN totals t
